verdict.rationale: Docs show Chroma indexes embeddings automatically and returns the n most similar results for a query. A community comment notes ANN index types (SPANN/SPFresh) on Chroma Cloud, so the core similarity-search part of the story is delivered. Nothing in the pack shows distance metrics can be configured. Missing for 10: any evidence of configurable distance metrics (cosine/L2/inner product), first-party documentation of the ANN index and its tuning, and hands-on corroboration.
